_comment: Baseball ontology IDs for the Geo knowledge graph. IDs are stable — do not regenerate.

types._comment: Types with 'existing: true' already exist in the space. Do not re-create.

ballpark.name: Ballpark
ballpark.description: A baseball stadium or venue where games are played.

season.name: Season
season.description: A calendar year of baseball activity.

game.name: Game
game.description: A single baseball game between two teams.

play.name: Play
play.description: A single plate appearance or at-bat within a game.

batting_performance.name: Batting Performance
batting_performance.description: One player's batting statistics for a single game.

pitching_performance.name: Pitching Performance
pitching_performance.description: One pitcher's statistics for a single game.

fielding_performance.name: Fielding Performance
fielding_performance.description: One player's fielding statistics at a single position for a single game.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.description: A single pitch thrown during a plate appearance, with Statcast measurements.

roster_entry.name: Roster Entry
roster_entry.description: A player's assignment to a team for a specific season.

ejection.name: Ejection
ejection.description: A player, manager, or coach being removed from a game by an umpire.

league.name: League
league.description: A professional baseball league or association.

position.name: Position
position.description: A defensive fielding position on the baseball diamond.

game_type.name: Game Type
game_type.description: A classification of game context within a season.

handedness.name: Handedness
handedness.description: A batting or throwing hand preference.

pitch_type.name: Pitch Type
pitch_type.description: A classification of pitch based on grip, velocity, and movement.

pitch_call.name: Pitch Call
pitch_call.description: The umpire's ruling or outcome of an individual pitch.

play_event.name: Play Event
play_event.description: The outcome category of a plate appearance.

hit_trajectory.name: Hit Trajectory
hit_trajectory.description: The batted ball flight path classification.

sky_condition.name: Sky Condition
sky_condition.description: The weather and sky state during a game.

properties._comment: Properties with 'existing: true' already exist in the space. Do not re-create.

retrosheet_id.name: Retrosheet ID
retrosheet_id.description: Unique identifier from Retrosheet (e.g., 'ohtas001' for players, 'NYA' for teams, 'BOS07' for parks).

mlb_id.name: MLB ID
mlb_id.description: Unique integer identifier from the MLB Stats API.

city.name: City
city.description: The city associated with this entity.

state.name: State
state.description: The state or province associated with this entity.

country.name: Country
country.description: The country associated with this entity.

league.name: League
league.description: The baseball league this team belongs to.

season.name: Season
season.description: The season this record belongs to.

team.name: Team
team.description: The team associated with this record.

game.name: Game
game.description: The game this record belongs to.

player.name: Player
player.description: The player associated with this performance record.

batter.name: Batter
batter.description: The batter in this plate appearance.

pitcher.name: Pitcher
pitcher.description: The pitcher in this plate appearance.

game_type.name: Game Type
game_type.description: The classification of this game (regular season, postseason, etc.).

role.name: Role
role.description: A career role held by this person (player, manager, coach, or umpire).

handedness.name: Handedness
handedness.description: Batting or throwing hand preference (left, right, or switch).

pitch_type.name: Pitch Type
pitch_type.description: The pitch classification based on grip, velocity, and movement.

birth_city.name: Birth City
birth_city.description: The city where this person was born.

birth_state.name: Birth State
birth_state.description: The state or province where this person was born.

birth_country.name: Birth Country
birth_country.description: The country where this person was born.

death_city.name: Death City
death_city.description: The city where this person died.

death_state.name: Death State
death_state.description: The state or province where this person died.

death_country.name: Death Country
death_country.description: The country where this person died.

bats.name: Bats
bats.description: Which side of the plate this person bats from.

throws.name: Throws
throws.description: Which hand this person throws with.

hall_of_fame.name: Hall of Fame
hall_of_fame.description: Whether this person has been inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame.

mlb_debut_date.name: MLB Debut Date
mlb_debut_date.description: The date of this person's first MLB game.

last_game_date.name: Last Game Date
last_game_date.description: The date of this person's most recent MLB game.

first_year.name: First Year
first_year.description: The first year this team was active.

last_year.name: Last Year
last_year.description: The last year this team was active (null if still active).

surface_type.name: Surface Type
surface_type.description: The playing surface material at this venue.

roof_type.name: Roof Type
roof_type.description: The roof configuration at this venue.

left_field_distance.name: Left Field Distance
left_field_distance.description: Distance from home plate to the left field wall in feet.

center_field_distance.name: Center Field Distance
center_field_distance.description: Distance from home plate to the center field wall in feet.

right_field_distance.name: Right Field Distance
right_field_distance.description: Distance from home plate to the right field wall in feet.

start_date.name: Start Date
start_date.description: The date of the first game played at this venue.

end_date.name: End Date
end_date.description: The date of the last game played at this venue (null if still active).

game_date.name: Game Date
game_date.description: The date the game was played.

game_number.name: Game Number
game_number.description: The game number for doubleheaders (0 for single games, 1 or 2 for doubleheaders).

home_team.name: Home Team
home_team.description: The home team in this game.

away_team.name: Away Team
away_team.description: The away team in this game.

home_score.name: Home Score
home_score.description: The home team's final run total.

away_score.name: Away Score
away_score.description: The away team's final run total.

venue.name: Venue
venue.description: The ballpark where this game was played.

attendance.name: Attendance
attendance.description: The number of people in attendance.

day_game.name: Day Game
day_game.description: Whether this was a day game (true) or night game (false).

game_length_outs.name: Game Length (Outs)
game_length_outs.description: Total outs recorded in the game (54 for a regulation 9-inning game).

winning_pitcher.name: Winning Pitcher
winning_pitcher.description: The pitcher credited with the win.

losing_pitcher.name: Losing Pitcher
losing_pitcher.description: The pitcher charged with the loss.

save_pitcher.name: Save Pitcher
save_pitcher.description: The pitcher credited with the save.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature at game time in degrees Fahrenheit.

sky_conditions.name: Sky Conditions
sky_conditions.description: The sky and weather conditions at game time.

mlb_game_pk.name: MLB Game PK
mlb_game_pk.description: The MLB Stats API unique game identifier.

top_of_inning.name: Top of Inning
top_of_inning.description: Whether this is the top of the inning (true) or bottom (false).

at_bat_index.name: At Bat Index
at_bat_index.description: The sequential plate appearance index within the game (0-indexed).

event.name: Event
event.description: The outcome of this plate appearance.

rbi.name: RBI
rbi.description: Runs batted in on this play or in this game.

is_scoring_play.name: Is Scoring Play
is_scoring_play.description: Whether any run scored on this play.

outs_before.name: Outs Before
outs_before.description: The number of outs before this play.

outs_after.name: Outs After
outs_after.description: The number of outs after this play.

balls.name: Balls
balls.description: The ball count at the time of the event.

strikes.name: Strikes
strikes.description: The strike count at the time of the event.

runner_on_1b.name: Runner on 1B
runner_on_1b.description: The baserunner on first base after this play.

runner_on_2b.name: Runner on 2B
runner_on_2b.description: The baserunner on second base after this play.

runner_on_3b.name: Runner on 3B
runner_on_3b.description: The baserunner on third base after this play.

lineup_position.name: Lineup Position
lineup_position.description: The batter's position in the batting order (1-9).

at_bats.name: At Bats
at_bats.description: Official at bats (plate appearances minus walks, HBP, sacrifices, and interference).

grounded_into_dp.name: Grounded Into Double Play
grounded_into_dp.description: Times grounded into a double play.

is_designated_hitter.name: Is Designated Hitter
is_designated_hitter.description: Whether the player batted as the designated hitter.

innings_pitched.name: Innings Pitched
innings_pitched.description: Innings pitched in baseball notation (e.g., 6.2 = 6⅔ innings).

earned_runs.name: Earned Runs
earned_runs.description: Earned runs allowed by the pitcher.

home_runs_allowed.name: Home Runs Allowed
home_runs_allowed.description: Home runs allowed by the pitcher.

batters_faced.name: Batters Faced
batters_faced.description: Total batters faced by the pitcher.

pitches_thrown.name: Pitches Thrown
pitches_thrown.description: Total pitches thrown in the game.

game_started.name: Game Started
game_started.description: Whether the pitcher started this game.

complete_game.name: Complete Game
complete_game.description: Whether the pitcher pitched the entire game.

shutout.name: Shutout
shutout.description: Whether the pitcher completed a shutout.

win.name: Win
win.description: Whether the pitcher was credited with the win.

loss.name: Loss
loss.description: Whether the pitcher was charged with the loss.

save.name: Save
save.description: Whether the pitcher was credited with the save.

pitching_sequence.name: Pitching Sequence
pitching_sequence.description: The pitcher's order of appearance (1 = starter, 2+ = relievers).

fielding_position.name: Fielding Position
fielding_position.description: The defensive position played during this fielding stint.

innings_fielded.name: Innings Fielded
innings_fielded.description: Innings played at this position in baseball notation.

putouts.name: Putouts
putouts.description: Outs directly recorded by the fielder (catching fly balls, tagging runners, force outs).

assists.name: Assists
assists.description: Throws or touches of the ball that led to a putout by another fielder.

errors.name: Errors
errors.description: Misplays that allowed a batter or runner to advance.

play.name: Play
play.description: The plate appearance this pitch belongs to.

pitch_number.name: Pitch Number
pitch_number.description: The sequential pitch number within the plate appearance.

pitch_call.name: Pitch Call
pitch_call.description: The umpire's ruling on this pitch.

start_speed.name: Start Speed
start_speed.description: Pitch velocity at release point in mph.

end_speed.name: End Speed
end_speed.description: Pitch velocity at home plate in mph.

spin_rate.name: Spin Rate
spin_rate.description: Pitch spin rate in revolutions per minute.

spin_direction.name: Spin Direction
spin_direction.description: Pitch spin axis direction in degrees (0-360).

strike_zone.name: Strike Zone
strike_zone.description: Strike zone region from the catcher's perspective (1-9 in zone, 11-14 out of zone).

plate_x.name: Plate X
plate_x.description: Horizontal pitch location at the plate in feet from center.

plate_z.name: Plate Z
plate_z.description: Vertical pitch location at the plate in feet from ground.

launch_speed.name: Launch Speed
launch_speed.description: Exit velocity off the bat in mph.

launch_angle.name: Launch Angle
launch_angle.description: Launch angle off the bat in degrees.

hit_distance.name: Hit Distance
hit_distance.description: Projected total distance of the batted ball in feet.

hit_trajectory.name: Hit Trajectory
hit_trajectory.description: The batted ball flight path classification.

ejected_person.name: Ejected Person
ejected_person.description: The person who was ejected from the game.

ejecting_umpire.name: Ejecting Umpire
ejecting_umpire.description: The umpire who issued the ejection.

ejection_inning.name: Ejection Inning
ejection_inning.description: The inning in which the ejection occurred.

ejected_role.name: Ejected Role
ejected_role.description: The role of the ejected person (player, manager, or coach).
